title: DroneWashers
body: A drone-cleaning service concept with a complete website, service discovery, and an interactive quote journey.
detail: DroneWashers explores how to turn a service idea into a clear customer-facing experience. The site gives the concept a visual identity and a path from first impression to inquiry.

sections.label: THE IDEA
sections.copy: Make a drone-cleaning service easy to understand: what it could clean, how the process could work, and how a customer would inquire.

sections.label: THE PROJECT
sections.copy: A complete website concept with an animated drone, service sections, a coverage map, FAQs, and a sample quote flow.

sections.label: PROJECT STATUS
sections.copy: This is an interactive website concept. Service claims, prices, and testimonials are draft content; the quote form is a demonstration and does not send requests.
